en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 15. And from the previous chain from Ahmad b. Abi Abdillah from Muhammad b. Ahmad al-Sulami from Ja’far b. Muhammad from his father (a.s.) who said:

“O Muhammad! Peace be upon you, Allah has sent salutations to you. There is no place more superior in all seven heavens and everything present in them and all seven lands and everything present in them than rukn and maqaam. One who supplicates at this place from the time of creation of heavens and the earth but denies the love of Ali and later on meets Allah, He will surely throw that person in Hell.”
